description: Encode text to Base64. The text is converted to UTF-8 bytes first, so any language and emoji work. Set url_safe for the URL- and filename-safe alphabet (- and _ instead of + and /, as in JWTs and URLs), padding=false to drop the trailing '=' characters, and wrap to break the output into lines (76 for MIME email). Returns only the Base64 string.

text.description: Text to encode, taken as UTF-8.

url_safe.description: Use the URL-safe alphabet (- and _, RFC 4648 section 5).

wrap.description: Insert a line break after every N output characters. 0 = one line, 76 = MIME.

name: base64_encode
title: Base64 encode
